description: 한국원자력환경공단_부지감시시스템 지진데이터 현황_GW [nuclear facilities and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국원자력환경공단. 한국원자력환경공단이 제공하는 ‘부지감시시스템 지진데이터 현황GW’는 경주시 방폐물 처분장 부지 내·외부에 설치된 지진계망으로 측정된 지진 발생 현황을 집계한 자료이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국원자력환경공단. Its tags are 부지감시, 지진, 방폐물, 경주시, 처분장. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
